line_item_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

product_number.description: Stable Shopware product number/SKU. Required only for item_type=product.

item_type.description: Stable technical Shopware line-item type, e.g. product, promotion, custom.

unit_price.description: Exact non-negative decimal string. Binary floating point is forbidden.

total_price.description: Exact non-negative decimal string. Binary floating point is forbidden.
